name: crm-data-table
description: Tabular record data grid foundation featuring sticky sortable column headers, multi-select checkboxes, indeterminate selection states, custom cell renderers, and an empty content container.

visual_references.name: Twenty CRM
visual_references.purpose: dense record table with sticky column headers and row select checkboxes

design_constraints: Semantic table markup (thead, tbody, tr, th, td)
Empty container slot for virtualization or custom records

source_provenance.neutralization_summary: Extracted tabular layout semantics and header sorting interactions, replaced Linaria CSS with semantic Tailwind utility classes, and established empty rows/children slots.
